gloss: successive, all previous, through the ages

definitions.explanation: Refers to all holders of a position or all instances across generations. Used as a modifier before nouns to mean "every successive" or "all previous."

examples.japanese: {歴代|れきだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: To memorize the names of all previous presidents.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歴代|れきだい}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: This is the all-time best record.

examples.japanese: {歴代|れきだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{在任|ざいにん}→在任：19191_zainin⟧⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}かった→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who among all the previous prime ministers had the longest term in office?

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used as a modifier before a noun: {歴代|れきだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun or {歴代|れきだい} + noun (without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Refers to all people or things that have held a particular role or position across successive generations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴代|れきだい}⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧: all-time best/highest
- {歴代|れきだい}⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧: most ever, all-time most
- {歴代|れきだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧: all successive prime ministers
- {歴代|れきだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: all successive company presidents
- {歴代|れきだい}⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧: number one of all time
